verdict.rationale: Neon documents branching as a core primitive. Branches can be created and managed programmatically through the Neon API, the CLI, and a GitHub integration. neon.ts adds per-branch policy with auto-expiring TTLs (e.g. `{ ttl: "7d" }`) that can be applied from a CI job via `@neon/config-runtime`, and Neon Auth explicitly supports isolated 'preview or CI branches'. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented per-pull-request create/delete workflow (e.g. GitHub Actions steps or a deploy-platform preview integration) beyond page titles, an explicit branch-delete step for teardown, and independent hands-on corroboration of per-PR automation.
